claims.reason: coe_τ takes [NeZero M] only because of the section `variable (M : ℕ) [NeZero M]`: the statement mentions M, so Lean includes the instance-implicit variable automatically. Nothing in the statement needs it. τ is an abbrev in the same section; for definitions Lean drops unused section variables (withUsed/removeUnusedVars in Lean/Elab/MutualDef.lean, via Meta.removeUnused), so τ takes only M and σ. Its body is arithmeticRingAut (modularFunctionFieldFull M) σ, and arithmeticRingAut needs only [Field L] [Algebra ℚ L]. modularFunctionFieldBar is an abbrev under just `variable (N : ℕ)`. modularFunctionFieldFull and divisorExpansions do not use the NeZero instance: mem_divisorExpansions and jqd_mem_full mention them under `omit [NeZero N] in`. coeffMap and LaurentSeries do not involve M. The proof `rfl` unfolds τ and arithmeticRingAut, whose toFun is literally ⟨coeffMap σ x, _⟩; this is the same rfl that proves coe_arithmeticRingAut_apply, and no NeZero is involved. So with `omit [NeZero M] in` the statement still elaborates and rfl still proves it, for every M including M = 0.
